name: Sons of the Regent
lore: Following the Cataclysm and the shattering of the King, the Primal Regent has been leading humanity. A master of logistics and operations, he coordinates the movement of supplies through time and space, ensuring that the forces of mankind are always well-equipped to fend off the horrors of the universe. The legions of warriors modeled after him focus on victory not through brute force, but through superior organization and strategy.

rules.name: Wisdom of the Regent
rules.lore: The sons of the Regent strive to emulate their King in all they do. None accomplish this better than the Primal Regent they are modeled after. Inspired by recorded accounts of His deeds in battle, they employ ever-shifting tactics to respond to threats and eliminate their enemies. Few can match their flexibility and adaptability in warfare.
rules.text: At the start of each Battle Round, select one of the three Tactics below. It is active for your whole army until the end of the Battle Round.

options.name: Unrelenting Aggression
options.text: Your +Shattered Legions+ units can Shoot after making an Advance move.

options.name: Feigned Retreat
options.text: Your +Shattered Legions+ units can Shoot and Charge after making a Fall Back move.

options.name: Unrelenting Aggression
options.text: Your +Shattered Legions+ units can Charge after making an Advance move.

strategems.name: Second Vow
strategems.when: At the start of the Battle Round
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, if the enemy unit selected for "Vow of Eternity" is destroyed, the target unit immediately becomes selected for Vow of Eternity.

strategems.name: Inhuman Strategy
strategems.target: A "Wisdom of the Shattered" Tactic, other than the one chosen at the beginning of the Battle Round.
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, the target Tactic is now active for your army, instead of any other Tactic.

strategems.name: Protection of the Shattered King
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit declares an attack
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, attacks made against the target unit have their =shield-minus= Armor Break worsened by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

spells.name: Precognition
spells.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, this +Psyker+ has an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save of 5+.

spells.name: Scrying Gaze
spells.effect: Gain 1 CP. Until the end of the Battle Round, one friendly +Legion of the Regent+ unit within 18" of this +Psyker+ can reroll one Hit roll, Wound roll, or Save roll.

spells.name: Storm of Wrath
spells.effect: Select the nearest enemy unit within 18". Roll one d6 for each model in that unit; for each unmodified result of 6, that unit suffers 1 Mortal Damage.

upgrades.name: Scion of the Regent
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Blessings of the Shattered King
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ gains !Feel No Pain 6+!. If it already had !Feel No Pain 6+!, it gains !Feel No Pain 5+! instead.

upgrades.name: Records of Glory
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, select a "Wisdom of the Regent" Tactic. It is active for your +Warlord+ (and their attached unit, if any) for the entire battle.
